tools.name: search_affiliate_programs
tools.description: Search and filter the directory of affiliate programs (each compared by network, commission, cookie window, and a MODELLED value per referral). Use to answer 'best/highest-paying affiliate programs for X', or to find programs by category, network, recurring vs one-time, or minimum value. Returns a r

tools.name: get_affiliate_program
tools.description: Get the full record for one affiliate program by its slug (commission, cookie, network, how it pays, requirements, sources, verification date, modelled value).

tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: List the program categories (the keys search_affiliate_programs accepts) with a count for each.

tools.name: list_networks
tools.description: List the affiliate networks (the keys search_affiliate_programs accepts) with a count of programs on each.

tools.name: get_directory_stats
tools.description: Headline coverage: total programs, categories, networks, how many are verified against their own source, and how many the site lists that these tools leave out (with why).
